soundness_flags.label: Proposition 2 / diagnostic certificate
soundness_flags.one_line: The asymptotic held-out certificate quantifies only over an integer M>K_n although K_n grows; it needs an explicit sequence M_n and growth conditions sufficient for covariance convergence on V_{M_n}^J.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace M by a declared sequence M_n, state K_n<M_n, M_n→∞, and impose the empirical-covariance growth condition needed for the held-out dual norm; then state the diagnostic limit along that sequence.

Make the headline comparator chain more concrete by naming at least two published finite-weight implementations and giving an observable algorithm for their residual certificates, rather than relying chiefly on an abstract arbitrary-family comparison.

Add a theorem-level boundary corollary identifying a transparent class where the global optimizer lies in a published finite family, alongside a non-membership result on an open class; this would sharpen the strict-extension claim.

recommended_next_step: Revise Proposition 2 to specify the enriched-dimension asymptotic regime, then continue to Stage 0 with the field-tier global-attainment kernel.
